name: Curipod
tagline: AI builds interactive, discussion-driven lessons that teachers run live with their class.
description: Curipod is an AI lesson-building platform for teachers: enter a topic, grade level, and objective and it generates interactive slide decks with polls, word clouds, open questions, and drawing prompts that students answer live on their own devices. It gives real-time AI feedback on student writing and produces participation reports, aiming to drive classroom dialogue rather than passive viewing. Built for K-12 classrooms, it offers a free tier plus school and district licenses.
insight: Founded in Bergen, Norway; its makers pitched it as a 'reverse Kahoot' — teacher-built interactive lessons instead of quiz games.
edge: Turns a topic prompt into a full interactive lesson students answer live — combining AI generation with real-time polls, drawings, and writing feedback.
pros: Live polls, word clouds, drawing prompts
Real-time AI feedback on student writing
cons: Built for K-12, not higher ed
Unlimited use needs Premium or site license
